notes: Secure Flexi Term premium cell: the page's footnote says the renewal premium is NOT guaranteed and is recalculated for age at renewal (renewable option); the guarantee covers the original policy term.

Secure Flexi Term also states 'Guaranteed renewal up to age 101 regardless of health condition' (brochure, dated 1 April 2021) for the renewable term option; the no_medical cell uses the current page's conversion wording instead.
Secure Flexi Term and Mortgage Reducing Term: no entry-age range stated on the page or brochure, so entry_age is omitted.
Mortgage Reducing Term Assurance has no PDF; the page says 'disability', not 'total and permanent disability', and does not describe the premium basis.

Absolute Critical Cover: the ASCC Booster is an add-on; with it multiple claims up to 500% of coverage amount (Power Reset Benefit) plus Power Relapse up to 200%. Waiting and survival periods are mentioned but no length is stated.
Beyond Critical Care: 12-month wait between claims and 24 months for the same illness's relapse are stated, but no waiting period after cover starts is given, so waiting is omitted.

Diabetes Care: brochure dated 20 August 2020 (page confirms 5-question access, age 80 renewal). Eligibility also needs a non-smoker whose diabetes was diagnosed after age 25. Stages and claims not stated, so omitted.
Glow of Life: brochure states annual renewal is not guaranteed and premiums are not guaranteed; term/claims/stages not stated per metric definitions, so omitted.

Prime Critical Cover: special-condition benefits are one-time claims per condition (7 conditions) and reduce cover; an extra 50% applies after age 85. Stages and claims cell omitted as the main-claim count is not stated plainly.
Ultimate Critical Cover: early/intermediate stage claims are capped at 500% of coverage amount and S$350,000 per life (brochure footnotes). Coverage resets 100% after 12 months.
Protect 3: the product page says it is available exclusively to existing AIA individual and corporate customers and their spouses and children. No entry age range stated.

AIA Max VitalHealth Pro has three tiers: Pro A (private or public hospital), Pro B (public A-class), Pro B Lite (public B1 or lower), paired with AIA HealthShield Gold Max A, B and B Lite. The 5% co-payment and S$6,000 cap wording is identical across the three tiers in the brochure. No last entry age is stated for the rider itself.
